page_title: MNU 1-3 BHA | Manchester Utd v Brighton 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90+3' Brighton take a short corner kick.
90+3' Golden chance! Ansu Fati (Brighton) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
90+2' Hannibal Mejbri (Manchester United) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
89' Joao Pedro (Brighton) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Andre Onana is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

88' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
85' Erik ten Hag has decided to substitute Scott McTominay and he is replaced by Facundo Pellistri (Manchester United).
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) is coming onto the pitch as Lisandro Martinez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Erik ten Hag has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) replacing Sergio Reguilon.
85' A substitution has been made. Simon Adingra goes off and Evan Ferguson (Brighton) comes on.
84' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jarred Gillett blows for a foul.
82' Brighton are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
80' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

79' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
79' The ball possession at the moment is 43:57.
77' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Mahmoud Dahoud is replaced by Billy Gilmour (Brighton).
77' We are about to witness a subsitution. James Milner (Brighton) for Tariq Lamptey.
76' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

73' 1 - 3 Lisandro Martinez slides a pass towards Hannibal Mejbri (Manchester United) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the top right corner. The score is now 1:3.

71' 0 - 3 Goal! Tariq Lamptey finds Joao Pedro (Brighton) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the right side of the goal. Fantasy football! 0:3.
70' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

70' Anthony Martial (Manchester United) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Hannibal Mejbri.
64' Here's the change. Casemiro leaves the pitch and Hannibal Mejbri (Manchester United) comes on as a substitute.
64' We are about to witness a substitution. Anthony Martial (Manchester United) is replacing Rasmus Hojlund.
64' Here is a change. Adam Lallana is going off and Roberto De Zerbi gives the last tactical orders to Ansu Fati (Brighton).
64' It will be a substitution. Joao Pedro (Brighton) is ready to enter the pitch as Danny Welbeck walks off.
62' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner with a short pass.
61' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
60' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:3.
58' The resulting corner, taken by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), comes to nothing.
58' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) latches onto the ball in the penalty box and takes a first-time effort that goes a couple of yards over the crossbar.

57' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Jason Steele!
53' 0 - 2 Goal! A great through ball by Tariq Lamptey sets up Pascal Gross (Brighton) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
52' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
51' A crossfield pass from Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) fails to find any of his teammates.
48' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
47' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45+2' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well wide of the right post.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Adam Lallana (Brighton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
42' The Manchester Utd players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
41' Wait! Referee Jarred Gillett has indicated he is going to review the Manchester Utd goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if the ball went out of play in the build-up.
40' Goal! Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) takes a short pass from Marcus Rashford in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
40' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
39' Nice passing game by Brighton. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
36' Casemiro (Manchester United) trips an opposition player and Jarred Gillett signals a foul.
34' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

34' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
33' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) produces an awful long-range shot that goes high and wide.
31' Simon Adingra (Brighton) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
29' Brighton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

26' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
24' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
23' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) works the corner short.
20' 0 - 1 It's 0:1! Simon Adingra feeds Danny Welbeck (Brighton) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
18' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
17' Some neat passing and movement from Manchester Utd as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
14' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) plays a terrific long ball forward to Marcus Rashford, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
14' Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
12' A pass lands at the feet of Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
11' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
10' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Rasmus Hojlund, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
9' Brighton keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
7' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) gets on the end of the free kick, but somehow sends his header high over the bar from close in.

6' What an amazing save by Jason Steele! Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom left corner, but fails.
4' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
3' Manchester Utd work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
2' The Manchester Utd players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has just begun.
Brighton will kick the game off.
Jarred Gillett will referee today's match.
